name: Oh Inha
source:
A former dance crew member that doesn't hold back on expressing what she's thinking. Her critics often scold her for being rebellious and rude. 

She is stressed by the stalkers hovering around her and all the attention digging in into her private life. 

Mid-season voting results: 3rd place.

[Edited from English Official website]
